facts.statement: Banking amendments Oct-Dec 2025: IFSCA Banking Handbook COB Module 16 amendments relaxed director credit and buy-back restrictions (8 December 2025); Banking Laws (Amendment) Act 2025 compliance circular permitting up to 4 nominees (12 December 2025); Internet Banking Services review circular with compliance deadline 30 June 2026 (29 December 2025).

Capital-markets amendments Oct-Dec 2025: IFSCA (Listing) (Amendment) Regulations, 2025 (13 October) extended the financial-information timeline to 180 days, cut allotment/refund to 8 working days and moved to half-yearly post-listing disclosure; MII Governing Board PID circular (13 October); Global Access disclosure requirements (26 November); CMI liquid-net-worth clarification (30 December); CMI PO/CO deadline extended to 15 January 2026 via amendments notified 12 January 2026.

Fund-management amendments approved 22 December 2025: KMP eligibility relaxed via certification; PPM validity may be extended multiple times for VC and Restricted schemes; one-time 3-month extension for expired PPMs; 24-month custodian migration window (notified 2 February 2026). Finance companies: Companies (Board Meetings) Amendment Rules 2025 exempted FCs from Section 186 of the Companies Act (3 November 2025).

Other Q3 2025-26 updates: FCSS bye-laws notified 3 October 2025 with FCSS instructions for IBUs on 7 October; IFSCA (GIC) Regulations 2025 notified 24 December 2025 (multiple operating models, 10% domestic revenue cap, employee-transfer cap removed); consolidated bullion import circular for QJs/TRQ holders via IIBX with QJ net worth cut from INR 25 crore to INR 15 crore (10 October); V-CIP enabled for low-risk NRIs from specified jurisdictions (31 October); SEZ broadbanding notice (29 September), LOA-licence alignment by 31 December 2025 (29 October) and mandatory employee-data MPR reporting (28 October).
IFSCA (TechFin and Ancillary Services) Regulations, 2025 were notified 8 July 2025 with the transition circular for existing entities issued 31 July 2025.
IFSCA (Payments Regulatory Board) Regulations, 2025 were notified on 12 September 2025, replacing the Board for Payment and Settlement Systems (BPSS) framework.

Jul-Sep 2025 capital-markets updates: Master Circulars for 7 CMI categories - CRAs, Debenture Trustees, Distributors, ESG Ratings Providers, Investment Advisers, Investment Bankers and Research Entities (5 August); Global Access Framework revised (12 August); CMI PO/CO deadline extended to 31 December 2025 (4 September); Global Access amendments allowing Introducing Brokers to use PSP accounts (12 September); CMI net-worth compliance extended to 31 December (12 September); convertible debt securities listing clarification (18 September).

Jul-Sep 2025 other updates: Third-Party Fund Management framework with fee structure (24 July and 8 September); KMP Eligibility Guidelines under FM Regs 2025 (25 July); Transition Bonds Framework issued (29 July); finance-company prior-approval/intimation guidance circular (1 July); CERSAI onboarding directive for finance companies (7 August); bullion Market Access extended to the Bullion Exchange (11 September); bullion Trading Member experience requirement relaxed from 3 to 2 years (22 September).

ICSI Info Capsule regulatory timeline 2025: Consultation Paper on SPV Framework under FM Regs 2022 (10 January); Authority meeting approved CMI Regs 2025, KRA Regs 2025 and FM transition (27 March); KRA Regs notified 11 April and CMI Regs 17 April 2025 (capsule 21 April).

ICSI Info Capsule timeline mid/late 2025: Stewardship Code consultation paper (30 July); Market Access circulars extended to the Bullion Exchange (12 September); draft FinTech Sandbox Framework consultation and Payments Regulatory Board Regs notified (22 September); Stewardship Code circular issued plus differential-distribution consultation for Restricted/VC schemes (27 October).

ICSI Info Capsule timeline Dec-2025/Jan-2026: FM Regs 2025 amendments, GIC Regs 2025, BATF Amendment Regs 2024, CMI Amendment Regs 2025 and Registration of Business Amendment Regs 2021 (24 December 2025); CMI PO/CO deadline extended to 15 January 2026 (1 January 2026); Performance Review Committee Amendment Regs 2026 and Insurance Business Amendment Regs 2026 (12 January 2026).

ICSI Info Capsule timeline early 2026: MoU with the Malta Financial Services Authority, draft ETP Regulations 2026 consultation and draft IFSC Financial Advisers Regulations 2026 consultation (25 February); certification course specified for CMI KMPs and employees (6 April); AIF Amendment Regs 2026 reduced the Social Impact Fund minimum investment to Rs 1,000 and REIT/InvIT Amendment Regs 2026 reduced the credit-risk value from 12 to 10 and added Class B-I (20 April).

2024 baseline notifications: Payment Services Regulations 2024 (29 January, amended 2 April); BATF Regulations 2024 (4 June); CMI Regulations 2025 replaced the 2021 CMI regulations; Listing Regulations 2024 framework; AML/CFT/KYC Guidelines 2022 remain the compliance baseline.
